_comment: Published totals for Palworld 1.0 progression categories that the game's own
data tables do NOT enumerate.
Save files record only what a player has OBTAINED, so a save can never tell
you how much is left. These are published figures used as denominators, with
the cross-server union as a fallback for anything not listed.
SUPERSEDED — now computed from backend/data/gamedata.json.gz, straight from
the game's data tables, and therefore exact:
fastTravel = 174   (was listed here as unverified)
paldeck    = 303   (was 299; a save's PaldeckUnlockFlag keys on forms, not
Paldeck numbers, and 303 forms carry a Paldeck entry)
technology = 1413 points over 537 techs; 182 ancient over 51 boss techs (185 before v1.0.3 cut WaterBuildKit 4 -> 1)
REMOVED — fieldBosses was 65. Players on the reference server have between
them defeated 82 distinct field bosses, so 65 was simply wrong (it predates
the 1.0 additions). Rather than ship a figure known to be too low, the
category falls back to the observed union and is honestly labelled
'discovered'. Restore a number here only with a 1.0-current source.
CAUTION on observation-based validation: towerBosses was briefly set to 7
because that matched the most-advanced player's defeated count. That was a
coincidence — 1.0 has 9 towers (Auri & Shaolong and Zenara & Astralym were
added), and the player simply had not beaten the last two. A save can only
ever show a lower bound, so agreement with observation never confirms a
total. Prefer published figures, and treat matches as unproven.
If a figure here is ever lower than what a player has actually obtained, the
code falls back to the observed value, so a stale number can never produce a
negative 'remaining' count. That fallback is what exposed fieldBosses.
effigies = 396, RESOLVED from the game pak and no longer an estimate.
scripts/extract-effigies.py reads every relic actor out of the one World
Partition cell that contains them, pairing each actor's instance GUID with
its component's world position via the package export map. All 396 have a
position that lands in a streaming cell the game ships content for, and all
37 effigies the reference world's players had collected appear in the set.
It replaces 313, which came from a community tracker in the first commit and
was never verified. An intermediate scan suggested 149; that was wrong too,
because it counted distinct actor NAMES and the package name table dedupes
strings that many exports share. The export map is the authority.

_confidence.towerBosses: high — 1.0 list enumerated in full (Zoe, Lily, Axel, Marcus, Victor, Saya, Bjorn, Auri, Zenara)
_confidence.dungeons: high — matches DungeonPointMarkerSaveData (170) in a real save
_confidence.effigies: high — extracted from the game's own level data, GUIDs cross-checked against a real save (37/37)
_confidence.sealedRealms: medium — not cross-checked against a save
